en.text: Children are playing behind the house.

original: 私は一日中子供たちと遊んで過ごした。

en.text: I spent the whole day playing with my kids.

original: 彼女は友人たちと遊んでいる。

en.text: She is playing with her friends.

original: トムとメアリーは公園でシャボン玉を飛ばして遊んでいる。

en.text: Tom and Mary are playing in the park making soap bubbles.

original: 道路で遊ぶと危ないよ。

en.text: It's dangerous to play in the street!
Don't play in the street—it's dangerous.
It is dangerous to play in the street.

original: 子供の頃、毎日友達と遊んでいた。

en.text: When I was a child, I played with my friends every day.

original: 私たちが子供の頃は、毎日一緒に遊んでたよね。

en.text: When we were kids, we played together every day.

original: 外に行って遊んでもいい？

en.text: Is it OK if I go outside and play?

original: 子供達は庭で遊んでいた。

en.text: The children played in the garden.
Children played in the garden.

original: トムは外でお兄ちゃんと遊んでるよ。

en.text: Tom is outside, playing with his brother.

original: 子供たち何してる？寝てるの？遊んでるの？

en.text: What are the children doing? Are they sleeping or playing?

original: 子供らは外で遊んでるよ。

en.text: The children are playing outside.
The kids are playing outside.

original: 子供たちは家の外で遊んでるよ。

en.text: The children are playing outside the house.

original: 猫が犬と遊んでるよ。

en.text: The cat is playing with the dog.

original: 子供たちは公園で遊んでるよ。

en.text: The children are playing in the park.

original: 子供たちなら公園で遊んでたよ。

en.text: The children were playing in the park.

original: 僕と遊ぶの好きだと思ったのに。

en.text: I thought you liked playing with me.
I thought that you liked playing with me.

original: トムはハ長調のソナチネを右手だけ半音上げて弾いて遊んでいる。

en.text: Tom is having fun playing the Sonatina in C major with only the right hand raised a semitone.

original: 子供たちがビー玉で遊んでるよ。

en.text: The children are playing marbles.

original: あの子は一緒に遊ぶ友達が欲しいんだよ。

en.text: That child wants a friend to play with.

original: 息子は雨の中遊んでるのよ。

en.text: My son is playing in the rain.

original: 授業中によく指人形で遊んでたなぁ。

en.text: During lessons I would often play with a finger puppet.
During lessons I would often play with a hand puppet.

original: 向こうで遊んでる子に聞いてみるといいよ。

en.text: You can ask the child who's playing over there.
You can ask the child who is playing over there.
You can ask the child that is playing over there.

original: 三人の子供が公園で遊んでいます。

en.text: Three children are playing in the park.

original: トムと遊びたい？

en.text: Do you want to play with Tom?

original: その鍵で遊ばないで。

en.text: Don't play with the key.

original: トムは一緒に遊ぶ友達が誰もいない。

en.text: Tom has no friends to play with.

original: 子供の頃は、よく一人で遊んでたよ。

en.text: I used to play alone when I was a child.
When I was a kid, I used to often play by myself.

original: 妹は人形で遊んでるよ。

en.text: My younger sister is playing with a doll.

original: 遊ぶのは止して内に来てね。

en.text: Stop playing and come inside.

original: 子供の頃、よくあの公園で遊んでたよ。

en.text: When I was a kid, I used to often play in that park.

original: 友達と外で遊びたいな。

en.text: I want to play outside with my friends.

original: 近頃の子供は、外で遊ばないんだよ。

en.text: Nowadays children don't play outdoors.
Nowadays children do not play outdoors.

original: おもちゃの剣を持った少年が、一人で遊んでいた。

en.text: A boy with a toy sword was playing by himself.

original: 今遊んで、後で勉強していい？

en.text: Can we play now and study afterward?

original: 早く外に出て思いっきり遊びたい。

en.text: I want to hurry and go out, so I can let loose and have fun.

original: 子どもの頃、一緒に遊んだね。

en.text: We played together when we were kids.

original: 食べ物で遊ばない。

en.text: Don't play with the food.

original: 子供たちが雪の中で遊んでいます。

en.text: The children are playing in the snow.

original: 遊びたい！

en.text: I want to play.

original: 子供たちは、積み木で遊んでるわ。

en.text: The children are playing with blocks.

original: 一緒に遊びたいだけ。

en.text: I just wanna play with you.

original: 小さい頃、一緒に遊んだの覚えてる？

en.text: Remember when we were little and played together?

original: 父親は子供にボールを持って行き、子供はそれで遊んだ。

en.text: The father brought a ball to his child and the child played with it.

original: 子供たちはまだ砂場で遊んでます。

en.text: The children are still playing in the sandbox.
